content: अशिव {%a.%} .²1 Inauspicious, causing or threatening mischief; अशिवा दिशि दीप्तायां शिवास्तत्र भयावहाः (रुरुवुः) <ls>Rām.</ls> .²2 Unlucky, unfortunate. .²3 Unkind, unfriendly, envious. .²4 Pernicious, dangerous. .{@-वः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a certain divine being. .{@-वा@} A female demon or goblin. .{@-वम्@} .²1 Ill-luck, misfortune; grief; आपूरितं विमानं तद्भयशोकाशिवाश्नुभिः <ls>Rām. 7. 24. 5</ls>. .²2 Mischief.
